findings.title: KillSec threat profile (Halcyon)
findings.summary_md: Halcyon updated its KillSec threat profile on 13 November 2025, documenting the group as a Ransomware-as-a-Service operation that formalized its platform in June 2024. The profile records over 250 documented compromises, a $250 entry fee with 88% affiliate retention, and primary infection vectors exploiting misconfigured AWS S3 buckets and CVE-2025-31161. It notes the group reached over 250 victims with geographic concentration in India, USA, and Latin America, and had active operations through November 2025.

findings.title: KillSec ransomware attacking healthcare institutions in Brazil
findings.summary_md: Resecurity published analysis on 10 September 2025 describing a KillSec ransomware attack on MedicSolution, a Brazilian healthcare software vendor. The breach exposed over 34 GB of data containing 94,818 files, including unredacted patient pictures, lab results, and records related to minors. The attackers exploited exposed AWS cloud buckets rather than penetrating networks, affecting downstream healthcare facilities including Vita Exame and Centro Diagnostico Toledo.
